summary: Minimal, correct fix that restores 3.6.0 behavior for all-nan bar data by catching StopIteration from _safe_first_finite and falling back to safe_first_element; matches upstream resolution and handles both x0 and xconv symmetrically.

issues.description: Relies on StopIteration leaking out of cbook._safe_first_finite as the signal for 'no finite element', which is a slightly implicit contract between the two helpers; the explanatory comments mitigate this and it mirrors the existing exception-handling pattern, so not blocking.
